## Walkthrough

The instantiate function in bin/build-inline.ts now explicitly compiles WASM bytes to a WebAssembly.Module before instantiating, adding a compilation step between byte retrieval and instantiation.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **WASM Instantiation Enhancement** <br> `bin/build-inline.ts` | Modified instantiate function to compile WASM bytes to WebAssembly.Module via WebAssembly.compile() before calling raw.instantiate() |

## Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor Caller
    participant build-inline
    participant WebAssembly
    participant raw

    rect rgb(240, 248, 255)
    note over Caller,raw: Previous Flow
    Caller->>build-inline: instantiate(wasmBytes, imports)
    build-inline->>raw: raw.instantiate(wasmBytes, imports)
    raw-->>build-inline: instance
    build-inline-->>Caller: instance
    end

    rect rgb(240, 255, 240)
    note over Caller,raw: New Flow
    Caller->>build-inline: instantiate(wasmBytes, imports)
    build-inline->>WebAssembly: WebAssembly.compile(wasmBytes)
    WebAssembly-->>build-inline: module
    build-inline->>raw: raw.instantiate(module, imports)
    raw-->>build-inline: instance
    build-inline-->>Caller: instance
    end
```
